content: Sɑkɑri u mɑɑ nɔni seeyɑ kɑ̃siru sɔɔ mɑ u tire kureru ɡɑru wɑ tɑ yɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Mɑ Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ ɑ wɑɑmɔ mi. Mɑ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, tire kureru ɡɑrɑ nɑ wɑɑmɔ tɑ yɔ̃ɔwɑ. Ten dɛ̃ɛbu sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɔm soonu yɛndu. Ten yɑsum mɑɑ ɡɔm soonu wɔkuru.
Yerɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɔ̃riyɑ tɑ sɔɔwɑ yi yi koo yɑbi tem mɛ kpuro sɔɔ. Ten bee tiɑɔ, bɑ yoruɑwɑ mɑ bɑ koo ɡbɛnɔbu kpuro ɡirɑ minin di. Bee tiɑɔ mɑɑ bɑ koo be bɑ rɑ bɔ̃ri weesuɡii ko ɡirɑ.

Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinnin tiiwɑ u koo de bɔ̃ri yi, yi nɑ kpɑ yi ɡbɛnɔbun yɛnusu di kɑ sere be bɑ rɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yĩsiru bɔ̃re kɑm. Miyɑ yi koo sinɑ yi yin wɑ̃ɑ yeru ko kpɑ yi ben dirun kpɛɛkpɛɛku kɑ ten kpenu di.
Sɑkɑri u tɔn kurɔ ɡoo wɑ
Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo wi, u Sɑkɑri susi mɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ nɔni seeyo ɑ wɑ ye yɑ yɑrim wee.
Mɑ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ mi. Mɑ u nɛɛ, birerɑ mi, tɑ yɑrim wee tè sɔɔ tem min tɔmbu kpuron torɑnu yibɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bire ten wukiritiɑ ye bɑ kuɑ kɑ pɛɛrum yɑ wukiɑrɑ, yerɑ u kurɔ ɡoo wɑ u sɔ̃ ten sɔɔwɔ.
Mɑ ɡɔrɑdo wi, u nɛɛ, kurɔ wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ torɑnu. Mɑ u wure u kurɔ wi tɑɑre bire ten sɔɔwɔ, mɑ u wukiri.
Ye u mɑɑ nɔni seeyɑ wɔllɔ, yerɑ u kurɔbu yiru ɡɑbu wɑ kɑ̃siru sɔɔ. Kurɔ be, bɑ kɑsi mɔ nɡe kpɑkpɑyɛ, mɑ woo ɡɑ yi suɑmɔ. Mɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ bire te suɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ wɔllɔ.
Mɑ u ɡɔrɑdo wi bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mɑnɑ bɑ kɑ tu dɔɔ.
U nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ kɑ tu dɔɔwɑ Bɑbilonin temɔ. Miyɑ bɑ koo tu diru bɑniɑ. Bɑ̀ n tu bɑnɑ bɑ kpɑ, kpɑ bire te, tɑ n wɑ̃ɑ mi.
Sɑkɑri u tɑbu kɛkɛ nnɛ wɑ
